quests.title: The Empty Courtyard

dialogue.t: Could Columbina really...

dialogue.sit: (She stepped through the "Moon Gate." No one knows what's inside, but it's a place that tore apart the extremely powerful Rächer of Solnari...)

dialogue.t: Columbina?
Ah, it's you...
Are you... also waiting for Columbina to come back?
So, you too...
Hey... C'mon, don't be so sad. Keep your chin up...
If everyone was sad, that'd be like... like...
Paimon doesn't want to think about it...

dialogue.sit: (...I can't allow myself to wallow in guilt.)
(Columbina didn't sacrifice herself for us to end up like this, not to mention...)
Columbina, all of her friends... None of them would ever just give up like this...
Give us a little more time. I can't promise anything, but I'll do everything I can...

dialogue.t: Are they... cheering for us?
Thank you...
Do you need us to help you with something?
This kuuhenki... Paimon thinks it's the one who likes playing the lyre.
This kuuhenki... Paimon thinks she looks a little flustered...
Why don't you play something? If they hear a familiar melody, maybe they'll calm down a little bit...

dialogue.sit: Let's try the one Columbina always sings...

dialogue.t: Aww... They're asleep.
Looks like they haven't had a good rest in a long time...
Shh, let's leave.
Sandrone! What are you doing here?
What, am I not allowed to take walks now?
Thought as much.
No such thing as a free miracle, you know?
Hey, which way are you headed? Er, Paimon means... We don't see much of each other, maybe we could join you for a bit?
Let's not. I'm not in a good mood today, and don't have anything nice to say.
Besides, comfort is the last thing this place needs.

quests.description: The Silvermoon Hall is bathed in silence today…
